item.title: 3 Helpful Features to Have While Hiking with OsmAnd, Especially in India
item.description: Three features that significantly improve hiking with OsmAnd in India - a dedicated hiking rendering profile, offline Survey of India topo maps, and a large collection of raster map sources including satellite imagery and Strava heatmaps.
